channels.name: Clock+
channels.idle_level: LP-11 in Non-Continuous; HS-0 in Continuous

channels.name: Data0+
channels.purpose: Differential Data Lane 0 positive; bidirectional in LP.

channel_counts.external_wire_count: 4..10 (1 Clock Lane pair + 1..4 Data Lane pairs).

handshake_pairs.name: HS_ENTRY
handshake_pairs.rule: LP-11 → LP-01 → LP-00 → HS-0 → Sync → packet stream.

handshake_pairs.name: BTA
handshake_pairs.rule: TurnRequest → BTA Escape sequence on Data Lane 0.

handshake_pairs.name: ACK_TRIGGER
handshake_pairs.rule: LP Escape trigger byte 0x21 after BTA when no errors.

handshake_pairs.name: ACK_AND_ERR_REPORT
handshake_pairs.rule: Short Packet DT=0x02 carrying 16-bit Error Report.

handshake_pairs.name: READ_RESPONSE
handshake_pairs.rule: Generic/DCS Short/Long Read Response bounded by Set Max Return Pkt Size.

handshake_pairs.name: TE_TRIGGER
handshake_pairs.rule: LP Escape trigger byte 0x5D after BTA-without-command.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Host drives Clock Lane unconditionally. During HS, host drives all Data Lanes; during LP after BTA, peripheral drives Data Lane 0 only. EoTp Short Packet, when enabled, is the last packet of every HS transmission and is detected at the protocol layer independent of D-PHY EoT.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each Data-Lane bit sampled on a Clock-Lane edge (both edges, DDR). Header ECC validates DI+WC; payload Checksum validates payload. Errors accumulate in peripheral Error Register and are reported on next BTA via Acknowledge and Error Report Short Packet.

logical_signaling_levels.name: LP-00
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Bridge state before HS or Escape entry

ordering_rules.bit_order_within_byte: LSB-first on the wire (bit 0 first, bit 7 last).
ordering_rules.byte_order_within_header: DI (byte 0) → WC LS Byte (byte 1) → WC MS Byte (byte 2) → ECC (byte 3); little-endian over the wire.
ordering_rules.byte_order_within_checksum: CRC LS Byte first, then CRC MS Byte; CRC computed LSB-first over payload (per Annex B).
ordering_rules.multilane_byte_order: byte k → lane (k mod N); SoT replicated on every active Lane.
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Host → peripheral during HS payload (forward); peripheral → host during LP after BTA (reverse); never both ends HS-driving at the same time.
ordering_rules.transmission_order: Long packet: SoT → LPS → DI → WC LS → WC MS → ECC → Data0 → Data1 → ... → DataWC-1 → CRC LS Byte → CRC MS Byte → EoT → LPS.
